lines.text: I should call Maggie. Tell her I'll be late again.
Vault audit at nine tomorrow. Code 7-7-1. Same as it's always been.
One more cigarette and back in.
Lillian, did you file the Henderson papers? ... Good.
Maggie, I am NOT getting into this on the phone.
I'll be home when I'm home. There's an audit.
No — no, that is not what I said. Listen to me.
Last few signatures and we're done. Almost there.
Maggie? Maggie?! Hold on, I'm coming, just hold on!
Out of my way, please — emergency!
Coffee, black. And — has Lillian's ledger been turned in?
No? She said she left it here. Let me look around.
